decision: Retained with explicit limits: small, stackless cached CPU translation improves bounded Win95 throughput and most interpreter paged kernels. Largest interpreter TLB-thrashing case regresses; native RAM cases remain mixed. No general emulator or Rosetta equivalence claim.
measurementLimits: Alternating paired runs on one shared Apple M4 host; no confidence intervals or core isolation. An unrelated ARM/HVF guest was running. Fixed-instruction startup prefixes are not desktop boot times. Profiled application checks include OCR/control work and are not benchmarks. Captured state/counters match; no bytewise RAM equality claim.
